description: Orwateso ni rurimi rwa Nilotic orugambwa abantu nka obukaikuru bubiri n'ekicweka omu burugwizooba bwa Uganda, ahari Soroti, Kumi, Serere na Amuria, n'Abateso ba Kenya.
notes: Drafted by Claude (AI) for the Ateso courses (#131) with low confidence in Ateso; needs a native-speaker review. The Runyankore needs a native-speaker review too; word and unit notes fall back to the English notes (lang/en/about/teo).

why.title: Orurimi rwa **Soroti, Kumi n'ennyanja za Teso.**
why.text: Orwateso ruri omu ruganda rwa Ateker hamwe n'Orukaramoja n'Oruturukana, n'ahabw'ekyo kurwega nikukwigurira endimi nyingi kuruga Uganda kuhika Kenya na South Sudan. Ruyege ahabw'eka, orugyendo, emirimo, n'ebyeshongoro, emizano n'engano za Teso.

cards.title: Ahabw'eka
cards.text: Gamba na banyakuru n'ab'eka omuri Soroti na Kumi.

cards.title: Ahabw'abatambuzi
cards.text: Tambura kuruga Soroti kuhika Kumi, Ngora n'ennyanja Bisina.

cards.title: Ahabw'abarikwenda kumanya
cards.text: Shanga orurimi rwa Nilotic oruriho amaziina g'ekikazi n'ekishaija, kandi orutaine bika by'amaziina.

landing.audience: Abarikutandika, eka ezirikuruga Teso, n'abatambuzi abarikuza omu burugwizooba bwa Uganda.
landing.first: Okuramukya, okweyanjura n'enamba, bwanyima eka, ebyokurya, akatale, eshaaha, ebifo, omuka n'amagara, ekicweka ku kicweka.

cast.emma: Omugyenyi orikwega Orwateso atakagiire omu rugyendo
